You can filter by brand, but doesn't show every brand and won't allow you to select several at one time. You have to tap on filter again to select each additional brand. They ruined a perfectly good app.

They make it easy to spend, but hard to get your product or refund when they mess up. Stopped receiving my orders 3 months ago even though everything kept saying delivered. After a lot of bs got my money back. This week ordered something small to see if I'd get it. Got a delivery! It was scarves I ordered 3 months ago. Called about the item I actually ordered. Have to wait 7 days while they "investigate" for a refund. The poor service isn't worth the supposed convenience. Rather go to the store

Not usable! When I start the app, first I get asked to choose the right amazon (using amazon.de), then I should login. Login is not possible, because the app says I have no internet (what is not true). then I skip the login and get surprised with pics of dogs with the sentence "Oops! Something went wrong". This error was first seen last quarter of the last year! Errors may happen, but not repairing them is IMO the worst thing.

I love Amazon but this app needs A LOT of work. It freezes every few seconds the ENTIRE time I try using it. It makes me not even want to shop because it take hours to get anything to load and especially when you are trying to read reviews and look at customers pictures with their review. It is impossible to shop around with it crashing and freezing every few seconds. The updates are making it worse each time. Now I keep getting an "Amazon is not responding" message and kicks me out repeatedly.

Takes a while to load things. There are problems that I thought were just from my end, but they have continued past me getting a new phone and downloading the app. For example, random crashes, and not being able to add items to my lists (even after clicking on the "add to list" button a million times -- this persists on different phones, too). Also pictures of items not loading sometimes. Kind of annoying, with all the money Amazon has, these should be very easy fixes.

Garbage update. What is this "from" bullfeces! Oh this item starts at $8.99 but when you look at all the sizes and color options, $8.99 doesn't exist! All the items you are able to see start at $16.99. BAIT AND SWITCH PRICING! IT'S VERY TIME CONSUMING LOOKING AT ITEMS AND WAITING FOR ALL THE PRICING, SIZING, COLOR INFO TO LOAD ONLY TO NOT FIND THE PRICE SHOWN IN THE SEARCH LIST! Removed scrolling and replaced with next button eliminating knowing how many items are left.

Why changes?????? Now the vertical scrolling sticks and bounces back instead of scrolling smooth like it did previously. The horizontal scrolling is so sensitive that it's almost impossible to scroll right and Left without moving the entire screen up and down. The new icon menu is so confusing to find what you are looking for... it's not alphabetical or customizable. I wish developers would just leave perfectly working apps alone!

I had this app for years with no problems. About 4 months ago it started having a pop up screen to tell me the app had stopped working. The screen comes up even when I'm not in the app. I have tried to uninstall and reinstall several times. I tried shutting off my phone. Nothing worked. The last straw was when it stopped my GPS while I was driving and I missed critical information. I have now uninstalled and it will remain that way until they figure out the bugs.

What happened Amazon? Last few months this app has become plagued with bugs. Deleting/moving items in lists can take up to a minute for the 3 steps! Pages will disappear, and upon an auto-reload, it defaults to the home page 😒 Search results are a joke at times, the auto-correct does nothing to "correct" your search terms half the time. Someone, please, consider an overhaul of the front-end of this app. Trying to scroll within lists causes "jumping", where it wants to scroll the other way! Ugg.

I put in orders every 1-2 weeks at the very least and these new updates were they screwed around with the search filters is ridiculous. I don't even know if something is prime or not until I click on it. I'm beyond disappointed and I spend a lot of money with Amazon. I hope they're paying attention and get things back to where they were when you clicked the filter button and had choices and not this ridiculous list across the top or not having it at all.

It's SO SLOW. It's very frustrating to switch between colors/sizes of items, the photo previews take 3 times as long to load as the desktop browser version, and it freezes/crashes often - not just on this device. Mobile Chrome tries to force you to open all Amazon links on this flawed app, and it's sooo slowww I think I've time traveled to 1997 childhood: the days of floppy discs, dial-up modems and AOL.

11/4/23 - app has been locking up constantly for the last couple days. Had been working fine through the end of October. App is up to date (supposedly). I have tried force stop, clear cache, clear user data, disable/re-enable and even restarting phone several times. Nothing is helping. Something has broken the app and I'm pretty sure it's on Amazon's side, probably some update in the lead up to black Friday.

The app itself is slow. It often won't even register when you click on something. And freezes up a lot. Was hoping there was an update I missed, that would fix the issue. But there's no current update. It's pretty annoying when I am trying to shop for Christmas and Its super slow, and don't alwatsy register when clicking on something. Amazon itself is great. Love Amazon. But the app isn't so great

Very inconsistent app. that won't load anything. It often opens but just shows a blank page that is loading something but never loads anything. More often than not it won't let me view my orders or lists. Frequently crashes or freezes on me. It will often not respond then magically respond to several "clicks" and almost place an order for something I've never looked at. UPDATE: Dropped to 1 star because the app doesn't work 90% of the time!! 10-20 attempts to get the app to work!!

The Amazon app is sucking up SOOOO much data! What's the deal?? It's used 2G of data in the past 3 weeks. Granted, I've been Christmas shopping, but I've been hooked to wi-fi literally the entire time (thanks pandenic life), so why is it pulling the product photos & video from my data connection instead of my wi-fi connection?? How do I know it's doing this? Because if I turn off my data, no photos or videos that I click on will load. Get it together, Amazon! Use your billions to do better!

No longer allowed to see what products other people have reviewed. The interface is confusing, just lists of functions. Sponsored products crowd out relevant ones. Fast delivery times are promised and then switched once you order. Lower prices are shown for items in the search, but then true higher prices shown once you click an item. And thanks to their fantastic advertising, every "article" I open on Google is just a descriptive advertisement. Trash app, trash company.

Since the latest updates, this app struggles to let me see my orders. It's very frustrating to try and view your orders (or even the status of your order) and the app just constantly flickers for 5 or more minutes. I don't have the patience to wait any longer than that so I just close it completely. Please find a fix soon. Seems like the membership is going up but other areas (including multiple lost packages) have seemed to diminish. C'mon Amazon don't lose your glory.

N'ver mind, I'll just walk the 20 miles to the nearest Amazon warehouse. Like others said, the app has become SO slow and it's crashing just about every time I'm on. I've cleaned the junk from my phone without changes. I just noticed a new issue yesterday. Sometimes when I want to go back a page it brings me to the home page. I love Amazon and rely on it for items I can't find anywhere else, like a certain type of syringe needed for my son's meds. Please, PLEASE address these issues. Thanks!

Horrible algorithm, you have to know exactly how to search to find what you want, and your home page will be filled with the most useless items for you. It crashes, loads slow, bugs, and is generally inconvenient. Also they keep updating what the app looks like and every time it gets uglier and more inconvenient. The orders page has changed so my past orders and current are all combined and mixed making my orders extremely hard to visualize.

Ever since the update about a month ago this is the worst app ever, and so frustrating. Ridiculously slow. I could go to my computer and log in before this app loads its pages. Buttons have been moved to the bottom, which is not a big deal, but that's when the app somehow got really slow. Alexa button is always present and in the way even if you've disabled alexa. I've already switched to other stores for shopping, solely because it's no longer easy to shop Amazon with the new app versions.

I've ordered from Amazon a LOT in the past few years. Have been 100% satisfied with my service until this year. I lost my forklift key, which I need for work. I ordered some from Amazon and paid up for the fastest shipping they had available. I spent more than twice what the product was worth and it didn't get to me for SIX DAYS. Since I was in such dire need for the item I had to just grit and bare it. But man did they let me down..

I use amazon constantly it is very convenient. I have noticed a spike in pricing on items that i know i could get cheaper if i had the time to go to the store and purchase it myself. I pay for prime benefits to guarantee a faster delivery being in the same day. Now i have contacted customer care through their chat feature lastnight when a $30 gratuity was offered for my inconvenience and still have not received the gratuity.

Worked perfectly before update. After update... Pop-up shows activity. Go to pop-up and the program opens but never reveals activity. Just continually tries to load screen. If you go to the app manually, only parts of what you select will load, otherwise just continually trying to load page. Pretty much worthless. Roll it back or please fix the issues. After a bit of pages trying to load we get the dog page saying uh-oh, something went wrong on our end. Thank you.

Not a fan of yhe most recent update, the tracking map is always up which is fine but the information overlaps it so you can't fully see the entire map only about the top half, you can't adjust it to see the full map, it's annoying. Now today the app isn't working at all. They shouldn't make major changes until they are sure it works and makes the experience better!

NEED TO FIX THE APP! not only do they not ship out for days (yes with prime), they also dont charge till they ship out, causing a lot of confusion, and there's no option even close to fix this in setting, not only that, but when you try and place an order and you happen to close the app (just hitting the home button), when you open it again it freezes and you have to start all over again, I had to put in a new card, address and name 7 times becuase I had to answer texts!

Ok. That's all. Why? Because it's nearly IMPOSSIBLE to get in contact with them + the vendor's when you buy something & it comes wrong or anything like that (when the item does come damaged or just looks and resembles nothing as expected). Cancelling orders is a pain because the money can take 10 to 15 days to get back into your account. I'm giving 2 stars because I have bought a lot of nice things but I have also received bad service & items that didnt even match the picture/display & no refund

I have to reinstall every time I need support, then delete again. Otherwise, I am forced to use the app to browse Amazon. The app doesn't allow multiple tabs, so it is difficult to compare and contrast. However, recently Amazon requires the use of the app for the chat feature. I just install for support and then delete. If keep the app of Amazon didn't require you to use the app to browse.

Major Flaws. My main grievance is the inability to scroll through pictures on reviews. I used to be able to do this... But not anymore. If I want to look at pictures in reviews, I have to click on a picture but then cannot just scroll through by swiping (preferred) or clicking the next arrows on right/left of pic (prev this was available). To go back by hitting back button takes me two screens back and I have to start all over. And no zoom on review pics. Yuck. (Samsung Galaxy S9)

Ugh, Amazon. What have you done to the app? You've tinkered with the UI and made it awful. Did anyone UX test this? It's now dog slow. Getting into filters takes a couple of taps before it eventually lumbers into view. This is not good enough. It doesn't matter how pretty it is if it's unusual. The app should be fast, responsive and streamlined to let me spend £££. Instead, it's like you don't want me to browse and buy stuff. It's actually faster for me to browse your mobile site! Needs fixing!

Was great until the recent "update." They reformatted the UI to have the options at the bottom of the screen. Checking the status of an order now takes two extra steps and has a rather significant lag to open the order status menu. Sure, it's a first world problem, but I don't understand why they change things that don't need to be changed.

Poorly designed with poor service and poor customer support. I lost access to my phone number and was hoping I could get my account back by contacting customer support - too bad that you have to be signed in to contact them. I created a second account and wanted to add it into the app, the app just loads indefinitely and nothing happens. I will never understand how such a huge company can get away with some of the worst designed apps on the internet.

Automatically selects subscribe button to repeat every order you make. If you don't notice they will take your money every month or 2 and send you repeat products as a subscription. Then you have to go through the major inconvenience of cancelling and sending items back. Then trying to sort out the refund. This is WRONG on EVERY LEVEL. One time purchase should be the default, not subscribe. I hate it for this reason but understand it makes good business sense for ripping customers off. :-(

Cancelled prime deleted app. Can't use smile with app unless you allow phone notifications. Searches don't give real results and only show things they are trying to sell and not what I am actually looking for. Shipping problems (prime 1-2 day is a lie). Problems with returns, product quality, and authenticity. Lots of bait and switch where the reviews are for a different product then the listing. The autoplay videos are really distracting and not helpful.

Shopping cart doesn't load properly. Initially shows me be a dozen items. If I wait long enough it might load 6 more, then 6 more, etc etc. Sometimes doesn't seem to be loading at all. A SHOPPING app that doesn't have a properly functioning shopping cart? Really, Amazon? I am so tired of Amazon's inability to create intuitive design minus functionality issues.

Normally this app is fine, but this week it started freezing up for several seconds at a time and, even more annoyingly, popping up error messages "Amazon Shopping isn't responding" every two seconds that continue popping up *even after I have closed the app*! It gives the option of "close app" or "wait," but it only stops with the pop-ups if I click "close app." I sometimes have had the Amazon website open on my phone in Google or Chrome at the same time—I don't know if that's related?

I don't know why an update was needed to change how I view my lists, but if you could change it back so that when I click "Your Lists" I can view ALL of my lists rather than seeing the options "Grouped for you", "Your lists & registries", & "All saves". I already have my lists numerically & categorically organized! This change is a nuisance (I know, 1st world problems.)

Amazon customer for 15+ years and enjoyed using the app until recently. After last update app completely froze. It did not respond to any buttons. I restarted the app, cleared the cache, turned my Samsung phone off and back on. Still no response. Was impossible to delete app for reinstallation. Eventually the app reverted to the previous addition on it's own without the smile and worked. An update appeared in the Play Store. I am afraid to update for fear of reoccurrence of problem.

No accountability for delivery. The date provided for delivery in the app may or may not be the date the item is delivered to you. Upon calling Amazon about items marked as delivered but nowhere to be found, you have to give them another full business day and call back a second time before they will do anything, because "the driver may correct the issue." There is also no option in the app to click to state an item marked as delivered was not actually delivered.

I enjoy using the app but, everything has turned into and feels forced into Prime now. I've noticed most of everything I want to purchase never has any free shipping anymore. It's really rare to have a free shipping option. I can't afford to get Prime. Amazon has really taken over, stores have closed down. It just makes me sad. Things are no longer the same anymore. Amazon was cool before but now it's gone too far. I've started to just buying local products in my state or near me.

Neither this, nor the Amazon videos, lets you actually buy and watch certain series. Instead it tells you the cost, and that's it. Insanely useless. That's the whole reason I went to the shopping app. I wanted to watch Sharpe, which Amazon has available, but they won't give me a means to do so unless I've access to a PC, or want to slog through using a web browser on the phone. Utter garbage from a company that really ought be able to do better.

I used to use Amazon all the time. But, as of a few weeks ago. All my orders said the same thing, no delivery date, nothing, just a message stating an email would be sent when the items were available. I contacted customer service, on this issue. Mind you, all items I had ordered where listed in stock, and still are. There answer was not even remotely helpful. Unbelievable, such a huge disappointment. Now I guess I'll switch to Ebay.

I've been using Amazon for years. However recently their customer service has really tanked. They are rude, ignorant and over all make it very difficult to return things and get your money back. This is very depressing cause it's impossible to tell if something will fit, since all size 2, 5 ,10 are NOT the same. So if you can't try it on and return it without dealing with rude individuals what's the point of ordering stuff from them when they claim how easy it is to return things.

Although we utilized the prime membership heavily during the pandemic, I have to admit that we used it quite a bit before and most likely will afterward. Prices can be a bit higher than other places but the "free" shipping that costs $99/year more than makes up for it. I've started adding things to my cart that are only wanted, not needed or a necessity and save for later as you'll get a notification in those items when the price goes up or down. Also, keep a look out on items that have coupons!

Dreadful Update since Sept 2021. The app is now slow, common uses come up slowly and are not logically placed. I've been using the Amazon app for years and this is by far the poorest update ever. For example, finding order updates is now a multi step process and slow. I don't see any advantages of the new UI. The logo change last year was poorly executed as well.

Update 06/11/21: App is still awful. The menu font has been fixed, but bottom bar placement, and obscure submenus make using and find things difficult. Bring back the hamburger menu! UI update is awful. Menu bar at the bottom with buttons placed in inconvenient locations. Not excited about this. It makes using the App frustrating. Not only that, but the font in the menus are now huge and discombobulated. I'd rather use desktop view in mobile browser than this trash

With a recent update, the orders page now refreshes every time you return to it, which makes checking on your orders tedious and confusing. The cart page is buggy now too, often taking you to a recent search instead of to your cart. And half the time when you tap in the search field to edit a search, it clears the field instead. When you're trying to read a product page, there's a floating back-to-top button right in the middle of your view. Usability was never great but it keeps getting worse.

Update: they have removed the easily accessible chat button. So good luck getting in touch w customer service. Amazon also let's dealers use old reviews for new products. Original: If you use any of the sorting options (like "price: low to high" because you can't filter by price) it will take out thousands of options. Designed to make you waste time looking through thousands of items.

It was working well before they moved the search bar to the bottom. Who thought this was a good idea? It's hard to search one handed. Plus for us android users it gets in the way of home buttons. Please return the bar to the top. It was fine where it was. We aren't iPhones, we don't need things moved around constantly. If I wanted that I'd make the switch. No thank you. If this is the case, I'll just go in from chrome and delete the app.

What idiot thought it was a good idea to put the menu across the bottom of the app where the phone controls are??? Stupid move. I'll start using my laptop more now and avoiding the app. As a side note, the app crashes more now (freezes up when trying to go from different pages or scrolling). So that's just another reason to avoid using it. I wish developers would stop screwing with an app when it was fine before all this. Now it's just a hot mess.

WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE I HAVE EVER EXERIENCED!!!! I am so disappointed and frustrated with the experience I had when I needed a replacement order I have canceled my membership and will no longer use Amazon at all. I was a very active and loyal customer for two years and depended on them to help make my new life as a single mom easier. It really did until I had a problem with an order. Horrible communication problem in their customer service department. Online and on the phone

The new app doesn't work with my old phone anymore, so I had to Uninstall it and tried to install it in my new phone (which is the latest version of Samsung) still have problems, but it doesn't download, but before that had issues with the app very slow and other major problems. They should have stayed with the old app there were no issues or problems at all or at least for me, so they go from 4 stars to 1 stars.

The sort by price function is useless. removes almost all the results when sorting by price. I have ended up not buying from Amazon because of this on a number of occasions. Changed my rating after update and trying for some time.. one of the worst shopping apps now. filters and sorting are appallingly bad. Very frustrating. It's like being forced to look at only what Amazon wants to push.

I normally don't have an issue with the app. Yes it's buggy, yes it's slow. But usually you can get through it if your patient. But, for the last week or so, every time I get in the app it freezes within two minutes and I get the app not responding pop up. It's not only my phone app it's also my fire tablet app. Amazon's prices keep rising but they apparently can't afford to have an app that actually works.

This is the worst, most nonfunctional app I have ever used. It just doesn't work. Pages don't load. Menus are unresponsive. Notifications for packages are several hours late. Its honestly really upsetting that a company with as much money as Amazon can't even make a halfway decent app. You're better off using the Amazon website in your mobile browser.

Since a recent update it, the filtering is laggy. Also, the screen shifts due to showing/hiding your address line (so you end up tapping screen - which gets buffered ..... so when it wakes up you have actually pressed somewhere different!). It's not good! I even tried re-installing. Why oh why did they roll this out? So close to Xmas, either fix it quick, or, roll it back please.

I use Amazon a lot, and app was great. Until this version where results are now in pages and you see lot more sponsored items appearing per page. This makes finding what you want much harder, so much that I'm actually writing about it. Also filters can be better (but that's the same on the website too) Realtime tracking is helpful (introduced a few versions back) having an app feedback would have spared this 1 star review. Bring the pageless scrolling back and I'll make this app a general!

Pros: Using the app for purchasing is good. No issues. Cons: The lists never fully show what's saved in them on the aapp. I have to use the desktop to see my full list. Fixed a recent issue from a recent update in which only the home and cart icons work. After clearing the cache & data, uninstalling or removing updates, then re-updating, everything is working again.

Useful but broken. The 'my orders' screen does not load a majority of the time, it just gets stuck / frozen. This makes reordering items, handling returns, checking order status, and sharing product links all much more difficult than it has to be. It's been broken for months, and I've reported the bug previously with no response. I place many more orders than most people probably, which may be why I have the problem. FYI there is a workaround, you can go to 'buy again' and search for the order

The latest update made searching for specific items difficult! I tried to give it a few weeks and see if i just needed time to get used to it, but no it does suck! Search results are broad and fairly unrelated to what I'm actually searching for. Trying the filter isn't much help either. Trying to filter by brand still shows cheap knock-offs an look-alikes. Trying to filter by price range shows expensive look-alikes and SPONSORED items, like you're trying to HIDE the items i actually want to buy!

It's not just the app. The Amazon website dosen't make sence. For example, if an item is listed as $8.40 and I click on it to add it to my cart the price immediately jumps up to $12 or higher. All prices are in Canadian dollars so I don't understand why they do this. There are tons of things about the Amazon website that are shifty like that. It's a completely dishonest company that seriously needs better standards and at least some percision. It runs on complete chaos.

This app used to be great but after the latest updates in the last few months this app has been infuriating. None of my buttons work (orders, wishlists, settings/profile, address), pics won't load, and the app is extremely buggy. I've has to uninstall all updates and while my buttons do work now, it's still extremely slow loading (if things load at all).

Haven't used this app in about a year, but I decided to order something since I couldn't find it elsewhere. What a horrible mistake. The user interface and tracking in this app leave much to be desired, not to mention the package is currently a week late, and amazon seems unsure if it will arrive at all. I do my online shopping on eBay whenever possible, and this experience has heavily solidified that stance.

App makes it difficult to refine searches within the category. Favoriting only saves it to the default; holding it now (June 2023) just opens a heart .gif picture. There is no way to refine searches by "and/or" statements, since additional terms often just made the list longer instead of narrowing it down. I just found it was better and faster to search via Google.

I've found the search results often aren't accurate, and if I opt for filtering it as cheapest first, maybe with other filters too, it misses some results I had before which are cheaper. And, if I change any one filter, I need to order it again from cheapest first. It's a simple a major thing to sort for a big company. If things in my basket moved to purchase, it'll often automatically move my items to more avoidable expensive delivery options. If changed back to free, it'll load for too long.

Would really like there to be a receipt for orders. I'm old and actually balance my checkbook, so unless I remember to grab a screenshot of my order page, I have no idea how much I just spent. It's also very difficult to even find what it was I ordered, especially if I ordered more than one of an item. Better search results would also be great. Show me what I asked for first, and then other similar items, not a randomly jumbled up mix of what I asked for and a bunch of other stuff!

Uhh... at some point, it wanted to charge me $60 more on top of the $90 worth of items I was going to purchase. No thanks. App is a little confusing too. Hoping amazon could have set prices for the items being sold instead of the range of numbers like ($20-$45) or says it's $2 but when you click on the product, it turns into $16. Stuff like that.

LOVE AMAZON, but this app is horrible for searches. It doesn't retain the filter from one page to another. I refine it down to 98 items, and when I'm forced to go to the "NEXT" page after only seeing 20 items, I now get a page with 80,000 items and the filters are gone. Also, it starts out with thousands of items, but just by having it sort by price, it cuts it down to hundreds. Why when it's not supposed to filter anything out? PLEASE FIX so I can find what I want to buy.

The new design is soooooooo ugly and difficult to use. I hate it!! Please change it back!! It constantly refreshes to the top of the order screen, even when switching between orders. It only shows open orders, I want it to display ALL orders, whether they're open or not, delivered or in transit, returning or not. This is extremely annoying!

The app needs overall improvement. Tje recent update only allows you to select a single filter then it closes. If you need to select additional filters you have to keep going to back in to drill down to what you want. There is no back option in filters either so you cannot go back to the previous layer This used to work much better. Also if you try to sort your selection by price, for some reason, the number of selections you received in your search will change.

Avoid at all costs if you're in a non-English country. First time I tried to buy something, I opted to start a prime trial and they immediately locked my account. When I sent them a statement as verification, they couldn't verify because it wasn't in English. Yesterday, they charged the same credit card that they wouldn't verify with a prime subscription which I can neither use nor disable.

userName: Gordon Hamilton Currie, Lord of Glencoe
content: Have used the app to distraction for several years but this last couple of weeks it freezes. Takes ages before it works again! Extremely frustrating, given that Amazon have trained me like a monkey to use the app ad nauseam. I've uninstslled/reinstalled several times, restarted my mobile....read the reviews/frustrations of others....Uh oh! Something's not working... Sort it out quickly Amazon , or I, like 1000's of others will defect.

I have found with the vision issues I have developed for the last year or so. It has been becoming harder to read and see the print is to light. It would be nice if you incorporated a dark mode where black background and white print I find easier to read. Plus those with dyslexia also do better with dark mode for which I do have and has been acting up as well plus it would be nice if you also incorporate the ability To Adjust text size and style along with text to speech.

I will agree with many users the search bar location is terrible and always hidden, and when you do search for a specific item Amazon decides to pick a "favorite" on the list, and it continuously shows every 3-4 items.. My biggest gripe is the "now included video clips" for every item as you scroll is ABSOLUTELY ridiculous, getting a split second to see the photo before auto play is a (insert curse word) stupid idea, I now skip those manufacturers all together. Add a simple option to disable.

Amazon replaced the underground app, which worked and customers liked, with an annoying, slow, buggy POS which doesn't work and is apparently universally despised. Product Search is worse than awful. Eg, They sell Bench coats, but I can't find them, whatever search terms I use. Free delivery has to be applied manually each time & No I don't want Prime. I like Amazon, had some great bargains, but this app removes all the useability and most of the convenience. Quicker & easier to shop in town.

This app was previously functional on all of my Android devices. One of the updates is rendered this app completely unusable on every device I have. The app claims there's no internet connection when I've tried on multiple different methods. There are no useful support threads and Amazon just says to reinstall the app from the play store. An unfortunate experience when the website runs perfectly fine in mobile on all of the same devices.

I shouldn't have to turn on useless and annoying notifications for my purchases to count towards AmazonSmile donations!! Please fix this!! Also, the "back" button should take me to the previous item viewed, not the search input screen! The app has gotten worse over time, but the website isn't much better since you can't REALLY sort items by price on either platform!

The touch calibration is GARBAGE! It seems that every time I use this app it is extremely sensitive to very minimal finger movement. I have noticed that minimal finger movement while using the app is often so annoying and inconsistent that I do not use this app on my Android anymore. When In the app especially on the right side of the screen - it will send me to different products or other content I did not want. (I also did use this app on my girlfriends iphone and it worked perfectly fine).

Performance: Feels like a web app. Constant lag in the UI, the animations stutter, and there are frequent white flashes between screens. I have a high performing device. Wouldn't be surprised if the app actually uses a webview internally. UI: Many small issues. Lists unintuitive, you need to click on the tiny link in top right to see all your lists.
